This loss meant that the brunt of the Shot event fell upon Charlie Melchior. He has gained us useful points in all matches and did a personal best of 34 ft. 8 ins. in the match against the Police at Imber Court.
Bergvalds retained his Weight and Discus titles and Charlie Melchior once again won the Javelin Throw.
